hero.title: For scale-ups with many investors and an incentive plan
hero.description: Every round adds investors, share classes and convertible notes, and the incentive plan grows with the team. Sttok keeps the official shareholder register, simulates each transaction on the actual register before it is signed and runs each employee's plan, with tender offers to give them liquidity.

includes.title: What a scale-up with several rounds and an incentive plan uses

rows.situation: A new investor comes in with a capital increase
rows.action: It simulates the increase on the actual register, including the pool and note conversion, and prepares the drafts in Word.
It calculates the conversion and its dilution, and records the new shares with their numbering.

rows.situation: Employees want to sell part of what has vested
rows.action: It opens a tender offer with price, caps, withholding and each beneficiary's net amount.

rows.situation: An employee asks how much has vested
rows.action: They see it in their portal: their units, their vesting schedule and their documents.

rows.situation: A shareholder wants to sell to another
rows.action: The offer is published on the secondary market and the transfer is recorded in the register when it closes.

rows.situation: The general meeting has to approve the round
rows.action: It sends the notice, collects signed proxies and early votes, and drafts the minutes with the result.

items.q: Is Sttok for scale-ups or only for established companies?
items.a: Both. A scale-up with several rounds already has many shareholders, share classes and an incentive plan. Sttok keeps the official shareholder register from the start, and grows with the company.

items.q: Can I simulate a transaction before signing it?
items.a: Yes. The simulator calculates capital increases and reductions, share sales, convertible notes and liquidation waterfalls on the actual register, and prepares the drafts in Word.

items.q: Which incentive plans does it manage?
items.a: Phantom shares and stock options, with their pool, grants, vesting and cliff, invitation letter and each beneficiary's portal.

items.q: Can employees sell what has vested?
items.a: Yes, through tender offers: purchase windows with price, caps, withholding and each beneficiary's net amount.
It is an add-on module at extra cost. Sales between shareholders are recorded in the register with their documents.
Standard plans range from €450/year for up to 10 shareholders or beneficiaries to €850/year for up to 50. Above 50, there is a custom plan. See the pricing page.
